title: Elemental Gem / Feather Token stacks >1 cannot be used: grants naming cooldownEconomy make the items stateful (quantity must be 1)
description: Found in eshyra-olc5.12.13. isStatefulMagicItemMechanics treats any entityGrant with cooldownEconomy as stateful, so a stack of 2+ gems/tokens is refused by use_item ('stateful item must have quantity 1') though the pack calls them stateless single-use consumables. Also use_item break-gem/use-token on the real pack is blocked by readiness (no clause for operation effects summon-elemental/token-kind-payload; F3/F2/F5 hooks pending). Decide whether stacks should be supported.
